## Checklist

- [ ] `gofmt -w .`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] New behavior / bug fix has tests
- [ ] No new third-party dependencies (stdlib only)
- [ ] Touched source files keep their file-header comment accurate
- [ ] Commit messages explain *why*, not just *what*
